column1: # Readable names of Ratchet & Clank's (2002) assets, for the editor's Assets dock: kind, class, name.
# Names come, in this order, from: Lombyte's moby class names (editor/moby_classes.tsv);
# GPL-3.0); the rest were named by hand for OpenRAC from each model's look.
# Written short in snake_case (small_turret); each name is its own, so a model that looks like
# another ends in the planet it comes from and a number (pipe_kerwan_2). A fourth column, -y,
# names the face of a flat model (a door, a panel) when it is not on +y, as the dock guesses.
